name: Pangeo / ESGF Cloud Data Working Group Analysis-Ready Cloud Optimized CMIP6
model_or_instrument: 27 CMIP6 climate models (e.g. ACCESS-CM2, CanESM5, EC-Earth3, MIROC6, MPI-ESM1-2-LR, etc.)
resolution: Various native grids bilinearly interpolated to 1.5° x 1.5°, daily frequency (1850-2100)
access: https://pangeo-data.github.io/pangeo-cmip6-cloud/ held in public Google Cloud Storage
